mvpFocus: Monthly shift scheduling for healthcare teams with manual planning and rule warnings.
addTeamMemberDescription: Create a team member in a dialog and manage existing entries from the edit dialog.
name: Name
nicknameHelp: Shown in planning and roster; when empty, last name is used.
mcpText: Core actions run through backend services so REST and FastMCP use the same logic.
registerPasswordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
loginOrganizationSlugRequired: This email is registered in more than one organization. Please enter your organization code.
loginRemovedAccountHint: If an administrator removed your user account, create it again using Join organization.
loginForgotPasswordHint: Forgot your password? Contact an administrator in your organization.
changePasswordIntro: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
changePasswordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
devicesIntro: Apps signed in with a device token. Signing one out takes effect immediately.
orgStaffResetPasswordSelfHint: Change your own password in Settings.
orgStaffModalResetBody: Set a new password for {{email}}. This applies to every organization that uses this login.
shiftTemplateCodeTaken: The short code "{{code}}" is already in use. Please choose a different code.
matrixHelp: Days as rows, team members as columns. Status: vacation, research, teaching, or free (all block assignments that day). With a shift group selected: wish or no-go per shift template.
wishesResponseAcknowledgedHint: Toggle when the team member has responded to your wish request.
planningPreferencesMatrixHelp: Same text for every month; you can also edit it under My profile.
periodRosterRefreshHelp: Applies current shift-group membership to this month. People who already have wishes or duties are removed only after you confirm.
periodRosterRefreshEmpty: This month already matches the shift group.
periodRosterRefreshDrops: Drops {{wishes}} day statuses, {{intents}} wishes, {{notes}} notes, {{assignments}} duties
refreshRosterConfirmBody: Adds new shifts from current shift templates and removes obsolete ones. Existing assignments on unchanged slots are kept; assignments on removed slots are cleared.
refreshRosterPublishedBlocked: Published shift groups cannot be refreshed
deletePlanningPeriodWarning: This planning month will be deleted completely. Requests, monthly notes, generated slots, and assigned shifts will be removed.
regenerateRosterWarning: This month's shifts will be regenerated from the current shift templates. Already assigned shifts will be removed.
finalRosterHelp: Days are rows, shift templates are columns. For each day and template you assign team members to the generated slots (multiple concrete slots stack vertically). Weekday, weekend, and holiday appear once per date; conflicts with requests are highlighted.
noShiftTemplatesForRoster: No active shift types yet. Create shift types first so the roster has columns.
planningWorkspaceHelp: One planning month controls requests, final roster, exports, validation, and workload.
dayStatusLegendTitle: Day status in wishes and roster:
planningDayIntervalHelp: Apply one day status (e.g. vacation, research) to every day from start through end.
planningDayIntervalOverwriteBody: {{count}} day(s) already have a different day status. Overwrite?
planningDayIntervalInvalidRange: Invalid range. From and to must be within the planning month and from must not be after to.
planningDayIntervalApplyFailed: Could not save the date range.
rosterDuplicateDayPlanningHint: {{count}} case(s): the same person is assigned more than once on one day (see highlighted cells).
rosterPickerMonthAssignmentsTitle: {{count}} shifts of this template assigned in this planning month
validationDetailUnavailableOverlap: Day wishes status: {{wish}} — assigned slot: {{slot}} (overlapped days: {{days}})
validationDetailConstraintSameDay: Rule: no additional shift on the same day (conflicts with: {{slots}})
validationDetailConstraintRestHours: Rule: at least {{required}}h rest, currently {{actual}}h (related shift: {{slot}})
validationDetailConstraintCrossDayUnavai: Rule: shift must not continue into an unavailable day (ends on {{endDay}}).
validationDetailConstraintMaxAssignments: Rule: at most {{max}} shifts of type "{{shift}}" per month; this team member has {{actual}}.
validationDetailConstraintCoupledShift: Rule: With "{{source}}" assigned, "{{partner}}" must also be assigned to the same person on {{partnerDate}}.
validationDetailConstraintTeamMemberProp: Rule: team member properties required for this shift are not satisfied (see shift template / variant).
validationDetailConsecutiveWeekends: Note: assigned on at least two consecutive calendar weekends (Saturdays: {{ranges}}).
exportRosterFileReadyHint: Excel and PDF export require a preliminary or published planning month.
exportRosterVisibleHint: Calendar export includes only shifts from preliminary or published planning months.
analysisHelp: Conflicts, rolling fairness, and workload for the selected planning month.
fairnessAccountsHelp: Actual, expected, and deviation per person over the rolling window. A positive deviation means above the expected share.
fairnessPickerDeviationTitle: Rolling deviation ({{dimension}}, {{window}}): {{value}}. Negative values are below the expected share.
workloadMonthHelp: Shift counts for {{period}} only. Do not compare these with rolling fairness figures.
complianceReportHelp: Statutory working time and tariff credit per person, assessed with the active rule-set version.
saveNowHint: All changes are saved automatically. This action reloads the matrix.
shiftTemplateBuilderDescription: Create a new shift template in a dialog and manage variants from the edit dialog.
shiftVariantApplicabilityHint: Controls which days this variant generates roster slots. Start-date rules cover most shifts; end-date rules matter mainly for cross-midnight shifts.
shiftVariantLimitWeekdaysHint: Generates shifts only on the selected weekdays. The preset filter above is ignored when this is enabled.
shiftVariantIncludeHolidays: Also apply on public holidays falling on these days
shiftVariantIncludeHolidaysHint: Off: no slot on NRW public holidays, even when the holiday falls on a selected weekday.
shiftVariantEndApplicabilityHint: Optional for cross-midnight shifts: limits the weekday when the shift ends (start date + end-day offset).
shiftVariantStartDayClassHint: Broad filter for the start date: weekday, weekend, holiday, or any day. For finer control (e.g. Mon–Thu), enable “Limit to specific days”.
shiftVariantEndDayClassHint: Broad filter for the end date on cross-midnight shifts. Leave empty when the end date should not be restricted.
shiftVariantWeekdaySelectionHint: Tap individual days or use a quick preset. Only selected days receive a generated roster slot.
slotPreviewDescription: Open a dialog with generated slot examples for the selected month.
shiftTemplateValuationOverrideHelp: A Bereitschaftsstufe belongs to this template. When set, this rule wins over the contract group.
deleteVariantWarning: This variant will be removed when you save.
constraintNoAdditionalSameDay: After this shift, no additional shift on the same day
constraintMinRestHours: Minimum rest time after this shift (hours)
constraintNoCrossDayIntoUnavailable: Must not run into a vacation/research/teaching/free day
constraintMaxAssignmentsPerMonth: Maximum number of this shift type per month
teamMemberPropertyRequirementNoDefinitio: Define team member properties under Team first.
constraintPartnerDayOffsetInfoButton: Show or hide day offset explanation
constraintPartnerDayOffsetHint: Calendar days to the partner shift relative to the source shift (e.g. 1 = next calendar day). Allowed range −7 to 7.
constraintCoupledNoVariantsHint: No other shift variants available. Add more variants or templates first.
constraintSeverityErrorHint: Prevents saving an assignment to this shift in the roster planner.
memberPlanningPatternsHelp: Apply during roster assignment and validation. They do not auto-fill the wishes matrix. Changes save automatically.
memberPlanningPatternIsoWeekCycleHelp: Writes a wish day status on off weeks (e.g. free/research). Roster checks can exempt weekends.
memberPlanningPatternAllowWeekendRoster: Allow weekend shifts during off weeks
memberPatternPolicyHardIsoWeekCycle: Allow ISO week cycle as hard rule (error)
validationDetailMemberPatternIsoWeekCycl: Pattern “{{label}}”: ISO week {{isoWeek}} is outside the cycle ({{onWeeks}}/{{cycleWeeks}} on-weeks, severity {{severity}})
memberPlanningPatternAvoidTimeWindowSeve: Time windows are always hints and never block roster assignment.
memberPlanningPatternRecurringWeekdayHel: Selected weekdays are written to the wishes matrix for open planning months (draft or preliminary). Manually edited days are left unchanged.
memberPlanningPatternRecurringWeekdaySyn: Fixed weekdays are written to the matrix; severity is always a hint.
memberPlanningPatternAvoidTimeWindowsSta: Combine several time windows (for example Wednesday 6–8 pm and Friday 2–6 pm). Set weekdays and times per block.
memberPlanningPatternAnchorAnyOverlap: All calendar days the shift touches
memberPlanningPatternWeekParityMatrixHel: For ISO weeks that do not match the chosen parity, the day status is written to the wishes matrix for open planning months (draft or preliminary); manually edited days are left unchanged.
teamMemberPropertyDefinitionsHelp: Define fields filled in per team member (e.g. training years, additional qualifications).
teamMemberPropertyMatrixHelp: Edit property values directly in the table. Changes save automatically.
teamMemberPropertyMatrixEmptyDefinitions: Create a property first to use the values table.
teamMemberPropertyMatrixEmptyMembers: No team members are available for this view.
teamMemberPropertyMatrixLoadError: Property values could not be loaded.
teamMemberPropertyFiltersAndHelp: All filters must match at the same time.
teamMemberPropertyFiltersNoMatches: No team members match these filters.
planningDayStatusDefinitionsHelp: Configure which day statuses appear in the wishes matrix, their labels, and colors. Statuses marked as blocking roster prevent assignments on that day.
planningDayStatusBlocksRoster: Blocks roster assignment on this day
workTimeRuleSetsHelp: Versioned statutory rule sets. Only one set is active. Editing a set already referenced by a plan snapshot creates a new version.
workTimePresetDisclaimer: Presets are engineering defaults, not legal advice. Confirm the numbers with the works council and legal counsel before use.
contractGroupsHelp: Contract groups define weekly hours, vacation entitlement, per-category credit rules, and day-status mappings. Employment percentage lives on dated periods per team member.
contractStatutoryFactorHelp: Independent of the credit factor: statutory working time (ArbZG), not tariff credit.
employmentPeriodsHelp: Non-overlapping ranges with a contract group and employment percentage. An empty end date is open-ended.
employmentReadOnlyHelp: Employment percentage is set by the organization on employment periods.
workTimeConsentHelp: Written consent for an extended weekly working-time cap. Corrections create a new record; revocation takes effect after the notice period.
workTimeConsentReadOnlyHelp: Your recorded opt-out consents. The organization records changes.
workTimeConsentImmutableHelp: Existing records are not edited. Record a new consent to correct one.
dutyActivityPrivacyHelp: Individual episodes are visible to the recording member by default. Other roles need an explicit grant. Aggregates stay available. Retention applies to the purge job.
dutyActivityIndividualReadRoles: Roles that may read individual episodes
dutyActivitySmallGroupThreshold: Minimum group size for works-council export
dutyActivityPurposeHelp: Please read the purpose before recording activity. The first capture is blocked until you acknowledge it.
dutyActivityPurposeEmpty: The organization has not entered a purpose statement yet.
dutyActivityWorksCouncilHelp: Aggregate utilization per duty type and month, with no individual attribution. Small groups are suppressed.
dutyActivityLiveHelp: One tap starts recording, one tap stops it. No required fields.
dutyActivityRetrospectiveHelp: Pick a past duty and enter start and end. The API checks the slot span and overlaps.
dutyActivityNoDuties: No stand-by or on-call duties in this list.
memberPatternPolicyHelp: Choose which pattern types may be saved as errors and block roster assignments.
memberPatternPolicyAvoidTimeWindowInfo: The “avoid time window” pattern is always a hint and cannot be stored as a blocking error.
memberPatternPolicyHardWeekParity: Allow calendar week parity as error
validationDetailMemberPatternWeekParity: Personal pattern “{{label}}”: only {{requiredParity}} ISO calendar weeks, assigned in week {{isoWeek}} ({{severity}}).
deleteShiftTemplateWarning: This shift template will be deleted. Variants, generated shifts, and already assigned shifts will be removed.
deleteTeamMemberWarning: This team member will be deleted. Related wishes, monthly notes, and final roster assignments will be removed.
shiftGroupsPageHelp: Create groups and assign team members and shift templates. Planning filters wishes, roster, and analysis by group.
shiftGroupMembershipHelp: Memberships run from a start date and optionally until an end date. Planning months that already exist keep their team members.
membershipInvalidRange: End date must be on or after the start date.
membershipOverlap: Periods for the same person must not overlap.
membershipRotationHint: The same person can have several periods (rotation).
teamMemberShiftGroupDatesHelp: Checking a group starts membership today; unchecking ends it today. Edit exact periods on the shift group.
planningShiftGroupHelp: Filters wishes, final roster, and validation by shift group. Templates not in any group appear only under All.
searchTeamMembersHint: Type to filter team members, pick from the list. You can add several; selected people appear as chips.
hoursHelp: Entries for the selected month, with contract hours, absences, and a running account that includes the opening balance.
hoursStatutoryCreditedHelp: Statutory work time and tariff credit are two separate columns. They are never added into one figure.
hoursRunningAccountHelp: Opening overtime plus credited minutes that count toward the contract, minus the contract target. Statutory minutes are not included.
hoursNoEntries: No time entries in this period.
hoursNoDivergence: No divergences between derived and effective values.
publishPlanningPeriodConfirm: Team members can then view the published roster for this shift group. Continue?
periodPublishedGroup: Plan published for this shift group.
periodSetPreliminaryGroup: Plan set to preliminary for this shift group.
periodSetDraftGroup: Plan set to draft for this shift group.
setPlanningPeriodPreliminaryConfirm: Team members can view the roster and leave comment feedback after this change. Continue?
setPlanningPeriodPreliminaryReopenConfir: The plan becomes editable again. The working version bumps (e.g. 1.0 → 1.1). Optionally mark as a major update.
planVersionHistoryEmpty: No saved versions for this shift group yet.
planVersionSaveHelp: Creates an immutable snapshot of the current plan (roster and wishes matrix).
planVersionPublishedReadOnly: Published plans are read-only. Set to preliminary to edit.
publishPlanningPeriodVersionConfirm: The plan will be published as this version and locked afterwards. Continue?
setPlanningPeriodDraftConfirm: Team members will no longer see the roster or submit feedback after this change. Continue?
unpublishPlanningPeriodConfirm: Team members can no longer view the final roster afterwards. Continue?
rosterNotPublishedYet: The final roster appears once planning has been published.
rosterNotVisibleYet: The final roster appears once the month is preliminary or published.
myPlanningPreliminaryBannerBody: This month is preliminary: you see the roster for orientation. You can adjust day wishes, wish/no-go per shift, and day comments until planning is published.
myPlanningWishesFeedbackHintDraft: Feedback: use the Day feedback box under each date. Monthly comment (above the matrix) is for notes about the whole month.
myPlanningWishesFeedbackHintPreliminary: Feedback: use Day feedback under each date to react to the preliminary roster; Monthly comment above for overall notes. Planners see this in the wishes matrix.
myPlanningRosterFeedbackRedirect: To send comments or change requests, use the Wishes tab (day feedback and monthly comment). The roster here is read-only.
myPlanningShiftsSectionHelp: Overview of your past and upcoming assignments (preliminary and published months).
linkedUserIdHint: Optional: numeric user ID (see User accounts under Organization). Clear to unlink.
profileHelp: Name, email, employment, and planning preferences for your visible planning.
settingsMembershipsHelp: Your active session always applies to one membership at a time. Roles and navigation depend on the organization.
settingsCreateAnotherIntro: You can create another organization at any time. You will be signed in there automatically as an admin.
settingsJoinAnotherIntro: Look up the organization code, confirm with your password, and submit a request. After approval, the organization appears in the list.
organizationSlugHint: Optional when your email maps to a single account. Otherwise enter your organization’s unique code (for example default or test-hospital).
registerCreateIntro: Create a new organization. You will become the administrator.
registerJoinIntro: Join with the organization code and your details. An admin will approve your request.
registerPageIntro: You only create a sign-in account here. You will connect an organization and role next under Setup or later in Settings.
onboardingPageIntro: Found a new organization as its administrator, or submit a join request with the organization code.
pendingOnboardingBody: Your request was sent to your organization’s admins. Once they assign you, planning and profile will appear in the navigation.
pendingOnboardingResubmitBody: There is no pending request (for example it was rejected or withdrawn). You can send a new request to the same organization.
selectTeamMemberToLink: Choose a team member without a login
orgManagementDeleteWarning: Permanently deletes the organization and all related data. Memberships in this organization are removed; accounts with no remaining memberships are deleted.
orgManagementDeleteTypeNameHint: Type the organization name exactly as shown: “{{name}}” (same spacing and letter case).
orgManagementPrepareTeamProfileHint: Optional: create an unlinked team profile with shift groups now. After the invite is accepted it links to the account automatically.
orgManagementShiftGroupsEmptyLine: This organization has no shift groups yet. Planner access and prepared team profiles need at least one group.
settingsOrganizationInviteAcceptNeedsPro: This invitation still needs team profile details. Fill them in and tap Accept again.
settingsOrganizationInvitePrecreatedHint: A team profile was already prepared and will link to your account when you accept.
organizationCodeHint: Share this code so colleagues can join your organization.
organizationTimezoneHint: Shift times are planned and shown in this time zone.
confirmApproveCreateTeamMember: Create team member and link account
deleteAccountWarning: Your account will be permanently removed. Linked team profiles are unlinked (no login). This cannot be undone.
soleAdminCannotDelete: The last administrator of an organization cannot be deleted. Add another admin first.
orgUserAccountsHelp: One row per email in the organization. Team profile and login account are separate; the link column shows whether the team profile’s user ID matches this email.
orgStaffLinkWrongUser: Team profile linked to a different user
orgStaffLinkForeignUser: Team profile linked to another email’s login
orgStaffClickRowHint: Click a row to edit the team profile, roles, and access.
orgStaffNoTeamProfileRow: There is no team profile for this email.
orgStaffDetailTeamMemberMissing: Could not load the team profile.
wishesPublishedReadOnly: Wishes are read-only because this shift group is published.
wishesVersionReadOnly: Wishes are read-only because a saved version is open.
wishesMonthEmpty: No comments or wishes this month.
wishesAnyShiftNoGoClear: Lift the no-go for every shift
wishesNoShiftThatDay: No shift of this group runs on this day.
wishesCommentNeedsStatus: A comment needs a day status.
changeSetChangedSince: This duty changed in the meantime.
inspectorEmpty: Select a duty, a team member, or a day.
paletteReasonStatus: The plan status does not allow this
workbenchNarrowNotice: This area is designed for larger screens.
memberCalendarLinkHelp: This link lists only your duties. Opening this export creates a new link, and older links stop working.
orgStaffRemoveSelfHint: Use Settings to delete your own account.
orgStaffModalUnlinkBody: Unlink the login from this team profile? The user account stays in the organization.
orgStaffModalRemoveBody: Permanently remove this user account from the organization? The team profile remains; the link is cleared.
dashboardUpcomingShiftsHint: All scheduled shifts from today onward (preliminary and published months).
dashboardUpcomingShiftsEmpty: No upcoming shifts in the next few weeks.
dashboardPastShiftsHint: Completed shifts from preliminary or published months.
dashboardPastShiftsEmpty: No past shifts in the selected period.
solverGenerateHelp: The solver proposes a month. Assignments are written only after you confirm, and every cell stays editable.
solverGeneratePublishedBlocked: Published shift groups cannot be generated
solverTimeBudgetHint: At most {{ceiling}} seconds for this organization.
solverOverwriteExistingHint: If off, already filled slots stay fixed.
solverApplyConfirmBody: {{count}} assignments will be written to the roster. Every cell stays editable afterwards.
solverLoadError: Could not load the solver run.
solverNoRuns: No solver run for this shift group yet.
solverRunningHelp: The solver is working. The result will appear here when the run finishes.
solverSectionHelp: Inspect the generated proposal, unfilled slots, and objective terms, then apply.
shiftSwapMarketplaceHelp: Claim open giveaways in your shift group and track the status of your own requests.
shiftSwapMarketplaceNeedsGroup: Select a shift group to see open offers.
shiftSwapNeedsTeamMemberLink: Ask an administrator to link this account to a team member before you can offer or claim duties.
shiftSwapPlanDraft: This plan is still a draft. Offers open once it is preliminary.
shiftSwapQueueNeedsSelection: Select a planning month and a shift group to see open giveaways and requests waiting for approval.
shiftSwapMemberPortalLink: Offer or claim duties in My planning.
shiftSwapOpenGiveawaysEmpty: No open giveaways in this shift group right now.
shiftSwapOwnRequestsEmpty: You have no swap requests yet.
shiftSwapOfferHelp: Publish it as a giveaway or propose it to a named teammate.
shiftSwapPickPartnerHint: Eligible people only, most under-served first.
shiftSwapNoEligiblePartners: Nobody is eligible to take this duty.
shiftSwapDeskHelp: What has not found a counterpart yet, and what is waiting for approval.
shiftSwapUnresolvedHelp: Giveaways and direct proposals without a counterpart, soonest duties first.
shiftSwapUnresolvedEmpty: No open giveaways or unanswered proposals in this shift group.
shiftSwapQueueHelp: Review pending swaps and warnings, then apply or reject.
shiftSwapQueueEmpty: No requests are waiting for approval.
shiftSwapErrorIllegal: This swap breaks a roster rule.
shiftSwapErrorIneligible: This person is not eligible to take the duty.
shiftSwapErrorConflict: Someone else already claimed this duty.
shiftSwapErrorInvalidTransition: That action is not allowed in the current status.
shiftSwapErrorExpired: The offered duty is in the past.
shiftSwapErrorNotOwner: Only the offering member can do that.
shiftSwapErrorNoEligibleClaimant: Nobody is eligible to take this duty.
shiftSwapErrorNotVisible: Swaps are available once the plan is preliminary or published.
shiftSwapFindingWorktimeRestAfterLongDut: Rest after a long duty is missing
organizationHolidaysIntro: Days treated like a public holiday, for example conferences or clinic-wide training days. They use holiday variants and the holiday credit bonus, and count as weekend/holiday duties for fairness.
organizationHolidaysSyncHint: Existing unpublished months are updated for that day right away. Assignments stay as long as the shift still exists on that day. Published shift groups are left unchanged.
organizationHolidaysRosterUpdated: Existing rosters updated: {{slots}} shifts changed, {{kept}} assignments kept, {{cleared}} removed.
organizationHolidaysSkippedPublished: Not updated because published: {{groups}}. Reopen the plan and sync the roster to apply it.
